name: Smoked Salmon Tostada with Avocado, Tomato & Cilantro Spread

instructions.primary_message: Drizzle both sides of the tortillas with oil and sprinkle with salt; arrange on a large baking sheet pan. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated), and bake, flipping halfway through, until tortillas are golden brown and crispy, 10-15 minutes. Remove from oven.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 small corn tortillas
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 pinch salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 avocados
3 tomatoes
½ small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and place in a medium bowl. Mash with a fork or potato masher until smooth.
Small dice tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the avocado.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl (reserving a small handful for serving).
Peel and mince shallots. Add to the bowl, along with mayo and spices, then stir to combine the avocado spread. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 shallots
2 tbsp mayonnaise
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Cut or tear smoked salmon into bite-sized pieces.
To serve, divide crispy tortillas between plates, then top with avocado spread and smoked salmon. Sprinkle tostadas with reserved cilantro and enjoy!
